meta.title: Tech+RFQ: RFQ stage before the technical response
gaps: Exact vendor-portal behavior and message shown when the RFQ stage is opened before the technical response, including whether the commercial stage is locked
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Exact vendor-portal behavior and message shown when the RFQ stage is opened before the technical response, including whether the commercial stage is locked

plan.title: Vendor cannot quote RFQ before technical response

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on its technical round without creating or changing the event.
Act as Vendor A in the supplier portal while leaving the buyer session available.
Attempt to open the commercial RFQ round before submitting the technical response; the step records whether the round opens or is unavailable.
If the commercial round is correctly blocked, the vendor should not see a quote submission control.
